value.name: reflect on house's temporary shelter
value.description: Asha reflects that the house has held her family and the woman who kept it running, and that it can only be expected to shelter them for a while longer.
evidence: had built her family inside it and the woman who had kept that family running and the two children who had not always known what to do with either of them, and it would, Asha thought, hold them a while longer, which was all any house was ever asked to do

value.name: consider limits of house paperwork
value.description: Asha thinks about the people who handle house paperwork and the limited promises they can honestly make.
evidence: and all any of the people who worked on the paperwork of houses could ever, honestly, promise
participants: people who worked on the paperwork of houses

value.name: sit with friends and wait
value.description: Asha sits with her friends and waits for the people who are supposed to arrive.
evidence: She sat with her friends and waited for the people who had to come.
participants: the people who had to come

value.name: morning continues outside
value.description: The morning keeps moving on outside while Asha waits.
